compiled_state.description:
## testing_mode: UPDATE

## Goal
Add behavioral test cases to `tests/scripts/test-migrate-closure-checks.sh` that verify the annotation-rewrite step from S9.

This is the RED test step: the new test cases must FAIL until the annotation-rewrite logic is added to `migrate-closure-checks.sh` (T2).

## File Impact
- MODIFY `tests/scripts/test-migrate-closure-checks.sh`: add annotation-rewrite test cases

Note: If `tests/scripts/test-migrate-closure-checks.sh` does not yet exist (created by S5/T-test), create it following the pattern of `tests/scripts/test-migrate-story-pr-bases.sh` with RED-state header comments.

## Test Cases to Add

### test_satisfies_annotation_rewritten_to_validates_closure_check
- GIVEN: a story ticket body containing `← Satisfies: "criterion X"` where "criterion X" is text that was moved to the parent epic's `## Closure Checks` section
- WHEN: `migrate-closure-checks.sh` runs on the parent epic
- THEN: the story body's annotation is rewritten to `← Validates Closure Check: "criterion X"`
- FAILURE: annotation still reads `← Satisfies:` after migration (orphaned pointer)

### test_satisfies_annotation_in_sc_unchanged
- GIVEN: a story ticket body containing `← Satisfies: "criterion Y"` where "criterion Y" is still in the parent epic's `## Success Criteria` (not moved to Closure Checks)
- WHEN: `migrate-closure-checks.sh` runs
- THEN: the annotation remains `← Satisfies: "criterion Y"` unchanged
- FAILURE: annotation is incorrectly rewritten

### test_zero_orphaned_annotations_after_migration
- GIVEN: an epic with mixed SC/transitional split and child stories with `← Satisfies:` annotations
- WHEN: migration runs to completion
- THEN: zero `← Satisfies:` annotations point to text absent from `## Success Criteria`
- Corresponds to DD2

## Acceptance
Tests must be in RED state (failing) when filed, confirming the behavior is not yet implemented.
